The '''"Knack" restraining bolt''' was a covert device produced by the infamous [[Brennkeyes Syndicate]], known for its high-quality yet illegal technology. It looked like a standard [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] but could be secretly preprogrammed to issue hidden orders to a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], either at specific times or under certain conditions. These commands ranged from harmless overrides to dangerous actions, such as redirecting a droid to a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base. The bolt's programming was only detectable via a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and remained hidden from those who inspected the droid's usual software.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Knack" Restraining bolt was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
